transcript.content: Hello, I’m Dr. ____. What brings you in today?

Hello. Um... well, I guess it's about church. I've been doing some... odd things, I suppose. Like at the potluck table, I'll just stand there holding the serving spoon up in the air... just not moving. Or... I'll fold the same stack of napkins over and over while folks are waiting on me. So... that's why I came.
Have you been hearing voices that other people don’t hear?
No. Um... I don't hear anything like that. Just... just the regular folks talking.
When you do those things, do you feel like you are choosing to do them, or do they just happen without you meaning to?
Um... I'm not rightly sure. I guess I just... do them. I haven't really thought on it much.
When these odd episodes happen, do you ever find yourself in a different place without remembering how you got there?
No, I... I don't think so. I'm always just... right there. Where I was.
When you hold still like that, if someone gently moves your arm or hand, does it stay in that position?
I... I don't rightly know. Folks don't usually go moving my arms around. I just... I just sit.
If someone gently moves your arm while you’re holding still like that, does it stay in the new position for a while?
Like I was just saying... nobody really touches me when I get like that. So I couldn't rightly tell you. I just... stay where I am.
When you are holding still like that, do you feel like you’re unable to move your body even if you want to?
I don't... I don't really try to move. I'm just... still. So I wouldn't know if I couldn't.
If someone gently moves your arm or hand while you’re holding still, does it stay where they put it?
I... I thought I just said. Nobody's around to be moving my hands like that. I really don't know what else to tell you about it.
When you’re standing or sitting still like that, if someone gently moves your arm or hand, does it stay in that new position for a while?
Doctor, you... you keep asking me that same thing. I just don't know. Like I said, there's nobody around to do that. I don't have a different answer for you.
During these episodes, can you make yourself move if you try?
I just... I don't try to. Like I said before, I'm just sitting there. So I don't really know if I can or not.
When someone gently moves one of your arms or hands during these episodes, does it stay in that new position for a while?
I... I really don't understand why you keep asking me that same question. I told you, there's nobody there doing that to my arms. I just... I don't know what else you want me to say about it.
Do you ever have gaps in your memory for important personal events or periods of time, as if they were blank?
No... I don't think so. I remember things just fine. There's no... blank spots or anything like that.
Have you recently started, stopped, or changed any medications or used any alcohol or drugs before these episodes began?
No... I don't mess with any of that. I'm just taking the same pills I always take. Nothing's changed.
During these episodes, do you ever hold your body or limbs in an unusual posture and keep them that way for a while?
No... I don't do that. I just sit like regular. I don't know why I would hold myself in a strange way like that.
During these episodes, do you feel aware of what is happening around you, or do things seem kind of foggy or dreamlike?
No... I know what's going on around me. It ain't foggy or nothing like that. I'm just awake like normal.
If someone gently moves one of your arms or legs while you're holding still, does it stay in that new position like a mannequin?
No... nobody does that to me. I move my own arms. If somebody tried to move my arm, I'd just put it back down. I ain't a doll or nothing.
Have you had any times when you were sure that someone was speaking to you or sending you messages that other people could not hear or detect?
No... I don't get messages like that. Nobody's talking to me that other people can't hear. Just regular talk, that's all.
Have you ever suddenly found yourself somewhere and not remembered how you got there?
No... I don't think so. I always know where I'm going. I just stay close to home anyway.
When you’re holding still like that, if someone gently moves one of your arms, does it stay in that new position for a while?
Didn't you just ask me about that? With the mannequin thing? ...No. Like I said, I'd just put my arm back down. It don't just stay up in the air.
During these episodes, do you find yourself unable to speak or very hard to get words out?
No, I... I can talk fine. Words come out okay. Just... don't always have much to say, I guess.
